other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes imputation statistics (e.g., median) independently on the test set rather than applying the statistics learned from the training set, which violates standard inductive learning practices.

summary: The agent developed a robust LightGBM solution with thoughtful feature engineering and multi-seed cross-validation. However, it made methodological errors with imputation by computing the median age over the entire training set prior to CV splits (causing internal leakage) and computing it independently on the test set (failing to freeze training parameters for inference). Additionally, the ensembling across seeds is a simple unweighted average.
